page_title: WOL 0-1 NOT | Wolves v Nottingham Forest 03/12/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+3' Morgan Gibbs-White goes off the pitch and Nicolas Dominguez (Nottingham) comes on.
90+1' Marshall Munetsi (Wolves) receives a diagonal pass, bursts into the box and shoots towards the left side of the goal. Matz Sels is well positioned, though, and it's a comfortable save.
90' 5 additional min. will be played.
90' A pass by Toluwalase Emmanuel Arokodare (Wolves) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Nottingham.
88' Toluwalase Emmanuel Arokodare (Wolves) sends a chip pass into the box, but Matz Sels is quickest to intercept the ball.
85' Today's match ends for Joao Gomes who will be replaced by Marshall Munetsi (Wolves).
84' Nottingham seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
81' That will be all from Yerson Mosquera who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Matheus Mane (Wolves).
81' Rob Edwards prepares a substitution. Jhon Arias is replaced by Toluwalase Emmanuel Arokodare (Wolves).
81' We are about to witness a subsitution. Ki-Jana Hoever (Wolves) for Jackson Tchatchoua.
79' Andre (Wolves) whips in a cross from the corner, but Matz Sels is well positioned and punches the ball away.
76' Rough tackle by Hee-Chan Hwang (Wolves). The referee blows his whistle for a foul. Nottingham win a free kick.
75' Jorgen Strand Larsen (Wolves) sends a quick through ball into space for his teammate who is lurking close to the offside line, but one of the defenders intercepts and clears the danger.

74' Jackson Tchatchoua (Wolves) attempts to find one of his teammates with a fine lofted pass, but the defence reacts well to intercept the effort. The ball is out of play. Wolves will have a throw-in.

72' 0 - 1 Omari Hutchinson showcases his great technique and produces a beautiful lofted cross into the box. Igor Jesus (Nottingham) meets the cross and gets himself onto the scoresheet with a header into the middle of the goal. It's 0:1.
71' 0:2 – this is the current number of shots on target.
67' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Dan Ndoye walks off the pitch to be replaced by Callum Hudson-Odoi (Nottingham).
67' Sean Dyche has decided to make a change. Ryan Yates (Nottingham) replaces Ibrahim Sangare.
67' Hee-Chan Hwang (Wolves) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Jean-Ricner Bellegarde.
67' Yerson Mosquera (Wolves) receives a yellow card.
66' Yerson Mosquera (Wolves) does well to dispossess the attacker with a slide tackle, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. A free kick has been awarded to Nottingham.
65' Andre (Wolves) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Tim Robinson blows his whistle for a foul.
64' Jackson Tchatchoua (Wolves) delivers a crossfield pass, but the ball is cut out before it reaches its intended target. The referee and the linesman both signal a throw-in for Wolves.
61' Elliot Anderson (Nottingham) earns the yellow card.
61' Tim Robinson blows his whistle. Elliot Anderson (Nottingham) commits a foul after dangerous play. Wolves will take a free kick.
61' Omari Hutchinson (Nottingham) sends a wonderful cross from the corner kick. However, the defence works perfectly to clear the ball and avert the threat.

60' Sam Johnstone pulls off a great save to deny Omari Hutchinson (Nottingham) after receiving a precise defence-splitting pass. The effort is headed for the right side of the goal, but the goalkeeper dives superbly to stop it. Definitely the best save of this match so far! Nottingham have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
59' Elliot Anderson (Nottingham) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Tim Robinson blows his whistle for an infringement.
56' David Moller Wolfe (Wolves) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit chip pass. The ball goes out of play and Nottingham will have a goal kick.
56' Nicolo Savona (Nottingham) makes a strong challenge and Tim Robinson blows for a foul.
54' Omari Hutchinson (Nottingham) swings in the corner, but fails to find any of his teammates. One of the defenders reacts superbly to get it clear.

53' Neco Williams (Nottingham) had a good opportunity from long range. His shot was directed towards the right side of the goal, but Sam Johnstone was alert and made a comfortable save. The referee points to the corner flag and Nottingham will take a corner.
52' Joao Gomes (Wolves) is punished with the yellow card.
52' Joao Gomes (Wolves) tackles a bit over-zealously and Tim Robinson blows for a foul. Free kick. Nottingham will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
50' Andre (Wolves) takes the corner which is cleared by the opposition's defence.
50' David Moller Wolfe (Wolves) launches a powerful cross from the corner into the box, but the ball is intercepted by the defender.
49' A crossfield pass from Yerson Mosquera (Wolves) fails to find any of his teammates. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Nottingham.
47' David Moller Wolfe (Wolves) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+7' Tim Robinson has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+6' Igor Jesus (Nottingham) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent. A free kick to Wolves.
45+4' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Nottingham.
45+2' Elliot Anderson (Nottingham) fails to find a teammate across the pitch with a long ball. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Wolves.

45+2' The game is interrupted. Yerson Mosquera (Wolves) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did. A free kick has been awarded to Nottingham.
45' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.
44' Celebrations are cut short for Nottingham as the referee indicates NO GOAL after the VAR review shows it was offside!
39' The Nottingham players halt their celebrations as referee Tim Robinson makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was an offside in the build-up play.
38' Igor Jesus (Nottingham) meets the corner and displays his eye for goal as he coolly plants a header from close range into the bottom left corner. The score is 0:1.
38' Omari Hutchinson (Nottingham) will try to find the head of one of his teammates from a corner kick.
37' Neco Williams (Nottingham) gets to the rebound just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by one of the defending players. Good work from Nottingham as they win a corner.
36' Omari Hutchinson (Nottingham) sends in the corner, but the keeper steps in and makes a save.
36' Igor Jesus (Nottingham) gets on the end of a good cross and shoots, but his attempt is inadvertently blocked by one of his own teammates. Nottingham will take a corner kick.

34' Dan Ndoye (Nottingham) anticipates the lofted pass and races into the box with just the keeper to beat. He shoots early towards the left side of the goal, but Sam Johnstone pulls off a great save to deny him.
32' Tim Robinson blows for a foul after Andre (Wolves) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
29' Omari Hutchinson (Nottingham) takes the corner kick and sends the ball among a huddle of players inside the penalty area, but one of the defenders clears it to safety.
29' Omari Hutchinson (Nottingham) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted. The ball is out of play and Nottingham manage to earn a corner.
27' Jackson Tchatchoua (Wolves) sends a long ball in, but Matz Sels comfortably gathers the ball.
26' Jhon Arias (Wolves) plays a through ball but overhits it. The ball goes out of play and Nottingham will have a goal kick.
24' The corner from Elliot Anderson (Nottingham) is cleared away by the defence.

23' Elliot Anderson (Nottingham) collects a pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender. The ball goes out of play. Nottingham are awarded a corner kick.
21' Omari Hutchinson (Nottingham) brings his opponent down. Tim Robinson has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul.
19' Nikola Milenkovic (Nottingham) receives a yellow card.
19' Nikola Milenkovic (Nottingham) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Tim Robinson blows his whistle for a foul. Wolves have a free kick.
19' Omari Hutchinson (Nottingham) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Sam Johnstone intercepts the ball.
18' Jean-Ricner Bellegarde (Wolves) makes an unfair challenge by holding his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball. Nottingham get a free kick.
17' Ibrahim Sangare (Nottingham) attempts to find Igor Jesus with a delicate little through ball from inside the box, but one of the defending players makes a timely intervention.
17' A cross is whipped into the box by Omari Hutchinson (Nottingham) and Nicolo Savona controls it well. He lines up the ball, but one of the defenders produces a timely intervention.
16' Jackson Tchatchoua (Wolves) crosses the ball forward but it is intercepted.
15' Omari Hutchinson (Nottingham) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Tim Robinson signals. Wolves have a free kick.
15' The Wolves players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.

12' Igor Jesus (Nottingham) meets a cross from Morgan Gibbs-White, but he cannot keep his header on target. It goes well wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Wolves.
11' Elliot Anderson (Nottingham) picks out Omari Hutchinson with a fine lofted pass, but the latter wasn't able to create some space to get into shooting range.

10' Jorgen Strand Larsen (Wolves) tries to play a through ball from just inside the box to Jean-Ricner Bellegarde, but one of the defending players is alert to the danger and makes a timely interception.

8' A wild pass somehow finds Omari Hutchinson (Nottingham) in space, he steadies himself and shoots from mid-range but sends it just over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Wolves will have a goal kick.
8' Elliot Anderson (Nottingham) decides to speed play up with a short corner kick.

8' Neco Williams (Nottingham) attempts a long crossfield pass, but the defence does well to intercept the ball. The ball goes behind for a corner. Nottingham will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
7' Nottingham quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
7' A raking crossfield pass from Dan Ndoye (Nottingham) lacks accuracy and the opposition gain possession. Nottingham force a corner. They send men into the box.
6' Emmanuel Agbadou (Wolves) sends a long ball across the pitch, but it misses its target. The ball has crossed the sideline. Nottingham are taking a throw-in.
4' Jhon Arias (Wolves) commits a rough challenge and Tim Robinson blows his whistle for a foul. Nottingham will take a free kick near the side line.
1' Andre (Wolves) sends a long ball forward to Emmanuel Agbadou, but he put too much power and the chance is gone. The ball is behind the touchline and Nottingham will take a throw-in.
1' The first half has just begun.
Wolves will kick the game off.
Tim Robinson was nominated as the referee for this game.
